changelog:
Initial release: full Windows desktop control via PowerShell scripts.

- Launch, close, focus, move, resize, and snap application windows
- Simulate mouse and keyboard input, including text typing and shortcuts
- Control Visual Studio Code: open files/folders, go to lines, open diff view
- Safeguards for user confirmation before closing windows, killing processes, and overwriting clipboard
- All actions script-driven, with clear PowerShell usage examples
